Each cell remains the full upper crop with the same identity, hair, face framing, skin palette and pixel scale.

Make the angry expression clearly but modestly readable: lower the inner brows slightly toward the nose and add slight nose-bridge tension. Keep brows natural and source-colored, never thick or black. Preserve eye spacing, compact source iris size and warm brown/olive hue, softened native pixel clusters and muted skin tones. Both pupils remain forward-facing and inside natural eyelid apertures. Half and closed phases preserve the open-phase brow placement. Half lids lower naturally. Fully closed eyes use opaque, source-colored pixel-art lids that cover both eyes; do not show pupils or gaps. Keep eyelid/brow transitions coherent without reshaping the head. No eye teleport or stretched iris, harsh white flash, blur, vector circles, or excessive near-black outlines. Preserve clean crisp pixel steps and exact full-crop composition.
